failure_characterization.interpretation: The Reference solver requests timestep reduction before the intended fine endpoint comparisons can be formed. P2E18 therefore does not establish a failed temporal-convergence/stability result; it establishes that the currently frozen Reference convergence contract is not refinement-invariant over this ladder.

observation: HeadCalc tests compartment and total residuals against CritDevBalCp and CritDevBalTot in rate units.
The residual contains storage-change terms divided by dt.
When convergence is not reached and fldtmin is false, HeadCalc resets the trial state and requests dt reduction.
The explicit Reference adapter exposes that as SW_SOLVE_RETRY_ADVISED with route legacy-reference-retry.
code_basis.inference_to_test_next: Holding the rate tolerances numerically fixed while reducing dt may shrink the implied integrated balance allowance toward floating-point scale. This is a hypothesis for a separate Reference-only diagnostic, not a post-hoc reinterpretation of P2E18.

next_permitted_action: Create a separate Reference-only diagnostic workunit that prospectively compares the frozen fixed-rate convergence contract with a timestep-invariant integrated-balance scaling on the same 36-case refinement ladder. Do not modify P2E18 and do not begin RossFast timing.
